messages:
incident-bot: Paging: prefix-cache alert (P2) — sustained KV miss spike on shard-3, latency > 300ms for 8m, error % up. https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/2201234567 :rotating_light:
amanda: I'm on it, grabbing logs and who is oncall now?
kenji: I'm oncall. seeing a big spike in prefix miss rates. top offending tenants: acme-inc, beta-ml, shopwise (IDs: t-312, t-98, t-741).
marta: tag:priority-high. Any recent deploys to runtime or routing?
kenji: not in the last hour. I suspect prefetch/prefix cache invalidation churn — maybe a bad snapshot landed that made xkey cardinality explode.
amanda: can we do targeted mitigation instead of full rollback? want to avoid evicting whole cache.
kenji: plan: 1) enable per-tenant cache bypass for the 3 worst tenants to ensure correctness 2) tighten their quota/rate to reduce noisy load 3) temporarily disable prefetcher on shard-3 to stop the churn 4) monitor latency and errors.
amanda: ok. let's throttle first, then toggle bypass. who can run the runtime flag?
devops-oncall: I can. commands: 
```
# throttle tenants to 50r/s per instance
redctl throttle set --tenant t-312 --rate 50r/s --reason "incident 2201234567"
redctl throttle set --tenant t-98 --rate 50r/s --reason "incident 2201234567"
redctl throttle set --tenant t-741 --rate 50r/s --reason "incident 2201234567"
```
kenji: running now.
(devops-oncall runs commands)
support-bot: Notice: throttle applied to t-312, t-98, t-741 by devops-oncall.
amanda: confirmed reduced QPS from those tenants in the dashboard. miss rate still high but trending down.
kenji: next: enable prefix/KV bypass for those tenants so reads fall back to origin for correctness. Command: 
```
# enable per-tenant prefix bypass (shard-scoped)
redctl cache set --shard shard-3 --tenant t-312 --prefix-bypass true --reason "incident 2201234567"
redctl cache set --shard shard-3 --tenant t-98 --prefix-bypass true --reason "incident 2201234567"
redctl cache set --shard shard-3 --tenant t-741 --prefix-bypass true --reason "incident 2201234567"
```
kenji: applied. Confirming 200/200 on toggles.
marta: any customer-facing impact? support team — prepare a proactive note that some customers are experiencing slower reads but correctness preserved.
support-bot: Draft created: "We are seeing a cache-related issue affecting read latency for a small set of customers. We've applied targeted mitigations to preserve correctness; performance may be degraded temporarily. We're monitoring closely and will update in 30 minutes."
amanda: good. please mention affected tenants by ID only, no PII.
support-bot: done, will send to account leads for t-312 and t-98.
kenji: now disabling the prefetcher on shard-3 to stop cache churn: 
```
redctl feature toggle --shard shard-3 --feature prefetcher --state off --reason "stop churn during incident 2201234567"
```
(devops-oncall): toggled prefetcher off.
amanda: after disabling prefetcher, KV miss rate dropped ~45% in 5m, tail latency improved ~120ms. good signal.
kenji: follow-ups: 1) keep throttles in place for 1 hour and reassess; 2) keep prefix bypass on until snapshot/compaction fixed; 3) run snapshot validation job on shard-3.
amanda: assigning action items: kenji -> run snapshot validation and coordinate snapshot rollback if needed; marta -> own customer comms and account notifications; devops-oncall -> keep throttles/bypass toggles and be prepared to revert.
devops-oncall: I'll stay on the thread for handoff. paging next-oncall in 30m for follow-up.
amanda: quick customer impact note for postmortem: 3 tenants affected, correctness preserved via bypass, higher latency for those tenants, we applied throttles and disabled prefetcher. no data loss, no widespread outage.
kenji: adding command logs for audit: 
```
# audit snippets
ACTION throttle t-312 50r/s by devops-oncall 2201234567
ACTION cache bypass t-312 shard-3 true by devops-oncall 2201234567
ACTION feature prefetcher shard-3 off by devops-oncall 2201234567
```
amanda: good. tagging incident channel and escalation: @eng-runtime, @eng-sre — please watch dashboards for cascading latency in other shards.
eng-runtime: (reacts :eyes:) will monitor.
kenji: status check in 30m. last_action: disable prefetcher + per-tenant bypass + throttles applied.
amanda: handing off to night oncall in 28m: @devops-oncall please summarize and post in #incidents as "handoff: mitigations live, monitoring, next steps"
devops-oncall: posting handoff now.
support-bot: Customer notifications sent to account owners for t-312 and t-98.
amanda: thanks team. if anything degrades, escalate immediately. I'll do the incident writeup template after stabilization. :thumbsup:
